environment: Linux CPU sandbox, Tesseract 5 chi_sim+eng, Noto Sans CJK
ref_normalization: Chinese and ASCII alphanumeric; whitespace and punctuation excluded

layout_first.strategy: synthetic page split at image center, left crop followed by right crop, Tesseract PSM 6

limits: Two authored pages, not representative of real book distribution
Large measured CER includes reading order, not only character recognition
Vertical/complex multi-column layouts may not split at exact center
Independent hosted CI gate only verifies synthetic scenario
